project.name: WebAssembly4J :: wasmos-embedder generated bindings
project.description:
Java bindings generated by webassembly4j-bindgen from wasmos:host/embedder@0.1.0 (per ADR-006). The sole content of this module is:
- The 8 generated source files under ai.tegmentum.wasmos.embedder.generated: * RuntimeInstance, HostProvider — resources whose bodies dispatch through the bindgen-2.0 runtime-provider SPI (see EmbedderRuntime below). * EmbedderCallbacks, ImportSatisfaction, Error, ErrorCode. * EmbedderRuntime — bindgen-2.0 runtime-provider SPI. The embedder implements this once (e.g. wasi-p2-rs's WasmcmEmbedderRuntime) and installs it via EmbedderRuntimeRegistry.install(...). * EmbedderRuntimeRegistry — single-slot registry the generated resource bodies consult. - A local copy of the WitResult carrier at ai.tegmentum.webassembly4j.bindgen.wit.WitResult so the module has no compile-time or runtime dependency on webassembly4j-bindgen (which is a maven-plugin-packaged build-time-only artifact).
Downstream embedders (wasi-p2-rs, wasm-cm) depend on this jar for the ADR-006 embedder surface and provide a concrete EmbedderRuntime implementation that maps the SPI onto their runtime driver (WasmcmRuntimeGuestLoader for the JVM lane).
Regenerate the wasmos.embedder.generated files with:
java -jar webassembly4j-bindgen/target/webassembly4j-bindgen-2.5.1-cli.jar \ --wit ~/git/wasm-cm/wit/wasmos-host/embedder.wit \ --package ai.tegmentum.wasmos.embedder.generated \ --output wasmos-embedder-generated/src/main/java \ --no-impl \ --runtime-provider EmbedderRuntime
